boundary.reason: simdjson's DOM parser and traversal API are C++; one extern C call translates the completed observation into a fixed-width record.
boundary.abi_test: test.sh checks C and Ada layout, symbols, nullability, readable padding, ownership, arbitrary Ada bounds, and failure publication.

portable.reason: C++17 with -O3 and no host-specific ISA compile flag; unmodified simdjson runtime ISA dispatch remains enabled.

native.reason: The portable flags add -mcpu=native on arm64/aarch64 and -march=native elsewhere.

limitations: The admitted call constructs and recursively traverses a DOM.
The adapter deliberately uses the ordinary owned DOM API rather than presenting DOM traversal as a streaming event API.
simdjson's complete contiguous padded input is passed without adapter concatenation.

lanes.api: flyology_json_bench_simdjson_dom uses dom::parser::parse with realloc_if_needed=false and recursively visits every DOM value.
lanes.observable_result: Checksum over decoded strings, names, value kinds, and container counts plus event, scalar, member-name, and exact input-byte counters.
limitations: The input must be prepared once with 64 readable padding octets; preparation is outside the lane only when the result records it as reusable.
DOM allocation, number conversion, recursive traversal, and per-call parser cleanup are timed.
The adapter does not expose number lexemes or error offsets.
No simdjson writer boundary is included.
No simdjson writer boundary is included.
No combined parse-and-write boundary is included.

other_limits: The upstream parser's DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH is 1024; its depth guard rejects when the internal depth reaches that value, so 1023 nested arrays around a scalar are accepted and 1024 are rejected.
Input length and parser allocation are bounded by size_t, address space, and available allocation.
The benchmark observation groups all numeric DOM categories and does not preserve spelling.
